title: Answer: consciousness is experience, accounted for by a maximum of intrinsic cause-effect power

statements.text: In integrated information theory, consciousness is experience itself, and the theory sets out to account for it in physical terms. Its presence is accounted for by a maximum of cause-effect power in a substrate, a complex, and the way an experience feels by how that cause-effect power is structured. An experience is identical to the cause-effect structure unfolded from that maximal substrate.
statements.scope: IIT 4.0 (2022) and the essay on free will (2022)

sources.quote: IIT aims to account for consciousness and its properties in physical terms.
According to IIT, the presence of consciousness is accounted for by a maximum of cause–effect power in the brain.
IIT proposes a fundamental explanatory identity: an experience is identical to the cause–effect structure unfolded from a maximal substrate
